memory_estimate.method: Twenty simultaneous n-by-width arrays, two maximum group-Gram stacks and 256 MiB interpreter/factor allowance. Distinct positive group sizes obey k(k+1)/2 <= n. Counts derived from checked inventory and actual factors. Conservative planning model, not measured RSS or a proven allocator peak. No n-by-n covariance is constructed in the inspected production path.

runtime_scenario_basis.interpretation: Sensitivity calculations only, not ETAs, empirical bounds or confidence intervals. Uncovered fits assigned the covered mean multiplied by 1,4,16; these assumptions may understate or overstate actual cost. Ideal parallel scaling; excludes input preparation, output audit, retries, optimization refinement and biological inference.

uncovered_workload_handling: Include all 187700 uncovered fits in the same complete production grid, with no pilot or omitted strata. Preserve per-fit timing, errors and optimization flags. Use accumulating full-run timings to revise planning by observed strata; no full ETA until adequate coverage. Resource exhaustion or excessive numerical errors stop the run with existing checkpoints preserved for reviewed continuation.
storage_estimate: 64 GiB allowance for fit JSON/checkpoint/manifest output; excludes separately budgeted ~58.35 GiB numeric input cache and subsequent audit outputs. Historical covered JSON estimate ~2.38 GiB is not a full-grid storage bound.
launch_requirements: Complete independent materialized-array audit with successful terminal exit
Pin final materialization receipt, manifest, input proof, resource assessment, code and factor sources in the production plan
Recheck available memory and disk before launch; apply CPUQuota=1600%, MemoryMax=128G, MemorySwapMax=0 and BLAS thread limits=1
Use existing complete-grid checkpoint runner and queue full-output audit; retain all numerical review flags
scope: Resource assessment for future complete ordinary-ML production only. Does not launch fits, certify calibrated inference, or remove any input. Local CPU allocation; no GPU, cloud infrastructure or new charges.
